config.title: Smart Fan Controller settings
config.description: Detected fan speeds: {fan_modes}. Leave any airflow field empty if unknown — it only helps weak fan speeds get a reliable estimate sooner.

data_description.data_collection: Records one CSV row every 2 minutes in the Home Assistant config folder, alongside configuration.yaml: smart_fan_controller_data_XXXXXXXX.csv (max 10 MB, auto-rotated). Useful for reproducing algorithm behaviour and identifying improvements during the beta phase.
data_description.defrost_entity: Optional: binary sensor, sensor or input_boolean that indicates when the heat pump is in defrost mode.
data_description.operating_entity: Optional: binary sensor, sensor or input_boolean that indicates when the heat pump compressor is actively running. Used to prevent useless fan changes while the compressor is off.
data_description.outdoor_entity: Optional: an outdoor temperature sensor. When set, a grey-box thermal model learns each fan speed's real cooling/heating power and skips speeds that cannot hold the setpoint at the current outdoor temperature. Each field below labelled "Airflow <fan speed>" is that speed's rated airflow (m3/h) from the manufacturer's spec sheet — filling in every detected speed lets the model share data across speeds instead of learning each one independently.
